verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own in-product AI assistant. It runs on a bring-your-own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini key, keeps sessions attached to conversations, and supports AI rules. It also offers AI compose, reply, and translate, answers questions from Missive's documentation, and can pull in proprietary data through custom MCP servers. However, the evidence never explicitly shows it producing insights or proactive suggestions from the user's inbox or analytics data; the summarize-inbox example relies on external Claude via MCP, not the in-product assistant. Missing for 10: documented in-product insight generation from conversation or analytics data, proactive suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant quality.
